event: He says, "Hah, that's fine. So this is what you do? Workout videos in the mountains?"
She props herself up on her elbows. "Kind of! It's my whole thing. Fitness, but make it a quest."
"The channel's cosplay fitness. An elf princess teaches you to live like a hero. Very niche."
She flicks one long pointed ear with a fingertip and grins, and says nothing more about it.
"The comments fight about whether I ever break character. It's my favorite thing ever."
She coaches a few people one-on-one too, she says, and weekdays she's a seasonal ranger.
"Provo Canyon, down by the river. I know every tree along it. Like, personally."
She sits up and brushes pine needles out of her hair.
She pulls a bag of snap peas from her pack, eats one with a happy crunch, and holds the bag out.
